CharacterModifierDef.description:
An attribute modifier a race or class gives its player. The amount applies at level 1 and grows by
``per_level`` for every level above it: ``amount + per_level * (level - 1)``. Units follow the stat rules:
multiplied operations take percent (``amount_percent``, ``per_level_percent``); ``add_value`` on one of our stats
takes its unit (percent for a share, points otherwise); a vanilla attribute takes either.

amount.description: Amount at level 1, in game units.
amount.title: Amount

amount_percent.description: Amount at level 1 in percent (5 means 5 %, the fraction 0.05).
amount_percent.title: Amount Percent

attribute.description: The attribute it modifies, e.g. realmforge:strength.
attribute.title: Attribute

operation.description: How the amount applies (vanilla's attribute modifier operations).
operation.title: Operation

per_level.description: Added for every level above 1, in the unit of amount.
per_level.title: Per Level

per_level_percent.description: Added for every level above 1, in percent, like amount_percent.
per_level_percent.title: Per Level Percent
